# SignalPM

> AI-powered product discovery platform that turns customer signals into prioritized features and agent-ready PRDs.

SignalPM ingests calls, support tickets, and usage data from tools like Gong, Intercom, Mixpanel, and Salesforce — then synthesizes them into a unified insight graph. Product managers can ask "What should we build next?" and get ranked feature recommendations, each linked to the customer quotes and usage patterns that support it. Every recommendation includes a full evidence trail. Output: dev-ready PRDs for Cursor and Claude Code.

## Key Capabilities

- **Signal Ingestion**: Connect Gong calls, Intercom tickets, Mixpanel usage data, and CRM notes into a unified insight graph
- **Prioritized Recommendations**: Ranked feature ideas backed by customer quotes and usage patterns
- **Evidence Trails**: Every recommendation links to which customers asked for it, what usage data supports it, and why it matters
- **Agent-Ready PRDs**: Output dev-ready specs that can be handed directly to Cursor or Claude Code

## Integrations

- [Gong](https://www.gong.io/): Call transcripts and conversation intelligence
- [Mixpanel](https://mixpanel.com/): Product usage data and analytics
- [Intercom](https://www.intercom.com/): Support tickets and customer conversations
- [Linear](https://linear.app/): Issue tracking and project management
- [Salesforce](https://www.salesforce.com/): CRM notes and customer data
